subject: dif do not for d parameters in two dimension data

messages.author: b207b6a270f65efc
messages.subject: dif do not for d parameters in two dimension data
parts:
Hello Phil

When i run differential item function by DIF function in mirt for two dimensional model in 30 subgroups.  for some subgroups in my data, analysis for "d" parameters take very long time and do not converge to any results even when i use mirtCluster(). it converge very fast for "a1" and "a2". any help?

model <- mirt.model('f1=1-14
                                  f2=15-35')

model11 <- multipleGroup(riz,model, group=group,
                                           invariance=c(colnames(riz),'free_means', 'free_var')) 

d2a <- DIF(model11,c('a1','a2'), scheme='drop_sequential')

Checking for DIF in 33 more items
Computing final DIF estimates...

d2d <- DIF(model11,'d', scheme='drop_sequential')
Checking for DIF in 30 more items                                        ========  it do not converge to any results after 24 hours
